claim: Only the original external power supply may be used with the tweezers. The 2022 manual names it as an XP Power VES255PS24 -- 90 to 264 V AC input, 255 W rated -- while the 2021 System Installation Guide names it as Aresis model PWS-001.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 General Hardware and Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed (sha256 1c112ed1...): printed page 9 (PDF page 11). Also Tweez 305/310 System Installation Guide, 2021 (sha256 1f664a72..., byte-identical in the installed folder and the lab archive): printed page 14 (PDF page 18). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. The two names may be one unit under the maker's and the reseller's part numbers; nothing here establishes that, so both are kept. Input voltage is in the claim only: the store's unit registry has no volt. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
